svg.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — Decoder
svg.desc: Follow attention first, then the feed-forward panel. The bottom return rail carries the attention-updated stream to the second normalization. Wires are logical dependencies, not a kernel timeline. The inspected SGLang reference offers optional bounded replay as a separate feature-gated serving path. The inspected extend path excludes speculative execution; its behavior must not be assumed to apply to dSpark verification.
